implementation: Exact current channel promotion queued with explicit UTC instants and IANA preview, captured target/dependency versions and initiating credential identity. Existing transactional store leases plus monotonic schedule claims fence execution. Current authority, immutable upload, channel, environment, target and readiness are checked around asynchronous work and atomic schedule/channel/environment acceptance. Cancellation is a direct versioned CAS; interrupted ownership retains fences until verified prior-writer recovery. API, CLI and dashboard use the same exact receipt.

limits: No exact-clock delivery guarantee: it starts no earlier than the approved instant and accepts before expiry; downtime, sequential due work and provider latency consume the window.

100 unresolved and 1,000 total retained schedules per root. Terminal history is not pruned or reused; new work is rejected when retained capacity is exhausted. GET returns newest 100 currently authorized entries.
Local apply-safe recovery restores its pre-operation database. Provider code-only compensation preserves already committed application writes, including writes by an unpublished healthy candidate.
Interrupted local work requires explicit fresh-authorized typed recovery. Unverified provider compensation retains visible recovery-required state and writer fences.
References use one supported local transactional control store; automatic supervisor leadership, database replication and multi-region availability are outside feature 05.
Disposable Docker/XFS profile certification is not production Railway certification. Production remains uncertified.
